notablePrerequisites: You have not cast an artifact spell using Muldrotha this turn.
description:
Cast the artifact that can be cast using {C}{C} from your graveyard by paying its mana cost.
Displacer Kitten triggers, blinking Muldrotha.
Activate Krark-Clan Ironworks by sacrificing the artifact cast in step 1, adding {C}{C}.
Repeat.
